book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Yesus nugau Ze naliupet Luk nug sikut weun

content: Wab air nug Uwait aiwag moroun.
Yesus go Nou zaueim daren daren, dudu esab asiu mui agen aiwag Uwait muranemen Nou zauan aiwag tebil oug mina, picareun.
Wab air tub zoimai, aiwag ginaginam aliag, Uwait moroun.
Yesus go peimai, eneun, “Iz petak pet awarem, e wab air go aiwag banou pet meun. Gonug duailel ipal unum zilarai dareu.
E duailel unum go agal aiwag asiu dareu, ipal aiwag tutak oimai, Uwait moromen. Bo, e air go aiwag tamacag pet. Go gonugau aiwag unum Uwait morou, go ee gau mabun aiwag tub i dareu.”
Yesus nug Nou zau e eg umau en aneun.
Yesus nugau tapaimaraneu dudu ipal agen enemen, “Aiwag naliu sil zau patai memen mui, iweu naliu dudu agen Uwait moromen mui uligan.”
Yesus nug koli awareun, “Go ag esab ulis pemen, ziwas zumau ebu iwai zaiagar agen alaimai, go zau unum eg wai mamam. Go zau memen aiwag unum ulagai numam. Aiwag tub gonugau pip i damau.”
Yesus nug aiu ses uhu banou zumau en aneun.
Yesus nugau tapaimaraneu dudu agen koli kanabai auremen, “Dubanou Ban, go igul eisab zumau? Ein igul amegai zuba, go ig abiu mamam?”

Gonug koli awareun, “Ag suban ameitai dacan. Dudu ipal agen ag polumaramam. Dudu asiu agen alaimai, izal wanim patamam, enai zemamam, ‘Iz Yesus, kolital imarabun du zoimai darem.’ ‘Ziwas ulis zou,’ amam. Ag go dudu betei sesamarian.
Ag malai aleu ze mui, malai saiu waiagab alaba, doiban, ag esilakian. Go igul petak amegai zumau. Sisiarabun ziwas go pigai i zumau.”
Guzenaimai, gonug kolital awareun, “Emgasag tub ebuan duailel agen asaimai, emgasag tub ebuan duailel abai iwai maimai, malaininamau.
Em e ebu mim banban emgasag ata atai ebu zumau. Ipal emgasag we banou pet zumau. Ipal emgasag ebeu banban ata atai zumau. Mesgai wag uminabun igul ata atai zumau ag pimamen.

Bo, go igul pigai i zumau. Amegai agal iwai zaiagar agen ag gusig pataraimai, eg maramam. Ag izal tapaimaranemin dudu izal ze, ze ze maranemen, gonun, ag gotulanemen zaueim agal ze doimai, hiacaranem zau oug hiacaramam. Ag imaraimai, emgasag gumaraneu dudu banban agal ebeagab maramam.
Ag igul go ebalagab guzenebi, agen izal ze naliu awaramamen.
Go ziwas pigai i zumau ebu, agal oiagab iau daimai, ein ze marabun dabeleu asiu i on.
Einen, izanag go ze mui dabeleu naliu ag marai. Guzenemin, agal iwai zaiagar agen ag polu ze mai darem aimai i awaramam.
Agal memeagar, anaiagar, apanagar, amanagar mui agal atanagar mui agal zaiagar agtal, ag agal iwai zaiagar agal ebeagab ebu maramam, ipal ag wagarebiag, noumamamen.
Ag izal tapaimaranemin dudu, gonun, duailel unum ag en aiag sisil aba zoimai, gasageim hiacaramam.
Bo, ag suban damamen, agal gagaliag ulig unum naliu damau, tutak i silai numau.
Ag gusig tapai dacan. Guzenebi, agal doropag muzmuz awau damau.”
Yesus nug Zerusalem uzan eg wamau en aneun.
Yesus nug koli eneun, “Ag Zerusalem gonugau iwai zaugul agen zoimai kolilai katorobi, uligaiban, ag abiu mamamen go Zerusalem uzan ulis unum eg wai mamam.
Guzenebi, duailel ag Zuda agaig daremen em manam wag uminai unamamen. Dudu ag Zerusalem uzan dacanemen, go uzan utei uzaneim uminai unamamen. Zerusalem uzan gasag dacanemen dudu, go uzan i simamen.
Ziwas go ebu, uhu banban zumau, go Uwait nug dudu agal zigulin macanemen koli ameg maramau. Getal Uwait nugau ze maranemen dudu agen sikut wemen, go petak zumau.
Ziwas go ebu, ailel enimaga mui, ailel geleagar ap zai darem mui ag bisomagar pet. Uhu banban e em ebu zumau. Uwait nug aigsisilaba, go dudu eg maramau.

Dudu ipal alalaimai, siag sil wagarebi, noumamam. Dudu ipal hiacaranem zau oug hiacarabun imaraimai, emgasag tub bitamam. Guzenai, emgasag tub ebuan duailel agen e uzan zo oi dabi dabi, betei Uwait go nugtal agal ziwas mazieu amau.”
Du Nugau Nag alamau.
Yesus nug koli eneun, “Aiu ses am, geil, ureb ebu igul ata atai ninamau. E em ebu wol banban, ibut ze ebu usaba, duailel ag go doimai, unum uminamamen.
Duailel ag go igul em ebu zumau gumei daremen, dabeleu asiu oimai, agal oiagab banban uminamamen. Ameag kualilamau, einen, Mesgai wagan igul gusig dareun unum iloialoiamau.
Go igul guzenaimai, duailel agen Du Nugau Nag Mesgai wag pi oug gusig banban mui al eiman alaba, pimamen.
Go igul zuba zuba, ag gusig tapai dacan, uminian, ag Mesgai wag ametai dacan, einen, Uwait ag imarabun ziwas go aleu.”
Gair gau nuaneu ebu, ag abiu am tapabun ziwas zoi dareu.
Yesus nug koli gonugau tapaimaraneu dudu tatau ze tub awareun, “Ag a gair mui, a ipal dabilan.
A gair gau nuaneu ebu, go ag abiu macanemen, go am tapamau ziwas zoi dareu.
Guzenai sul, ag go igul ata atai zuba, ag abiu mamamen, Uwait gumarabun ziwas zoi dareu.
Iz petak pet awarem, e dudu ulis daremen ag i noumamamen ebu, go ena igul zumau, ag pimamen.
Emes mui, e em mui unum tamamau, bo, izal ze i poamau, muzmuz damau.”
Yesus nugau tapaimaraneu dudu ag suban tapai dacan.

“Ag suban tapai dacan. Tam aba, ag ee banban agaimai, ag ze gusig umkoskos zamamen go dabuiag gugamau. Ag e em ebuan esab en dabeleu asiu umamen. Go igul nug ag eg marai daba daba, go ziwas ebu Uwait Banou nug pigai alai ag piaramau. Go malai heimai, egun wanem sul guzenaramau.
Go igul, dudu unum e em daremen ebu zumau.
Ag ziwas umkoskos suban gusig tapai daremen, Uwait nug ag gusig marabun en umkoskos auramamen. Guzenamamen, go igul ag ebalagab zuba, ag eg i maramau. Ag Du Nugau Nag amegwab suban tapai damamen.”
Ziwas umkoskos, Yesus nug duailel Uwait nugau ze Nou zaueim abai maraneu. Umaum go em manam wanib Oliv go ebu ninabun bitaneu.
Duailel go Yesus nugau ze duabun umkoskos umaseutal bitanemen.
